title: Life Is Good
lyrics: Verse 1:
[E]Life is good with You, [A]Lord, with You, [E]Lord.
[E]Life is bad when I'm away from [B]You.
[E]Life is good with You, [A]Lord, with You, [E]Lord.
[E]Show me the bad and show me the good.
Help me [B]keep my eyes on [E]You!
See I've been [E]thinkin'...'bout my Jesus.
How He saved me and how He gave me this [B]life above.
And I [E]remember...that sacrifice of glory.
How He saught me and how He bought me with[B] His unfailin[E]g love -
and now I'm singin'
I was alone when You met me.
I was on my own and I had no home.
I was dark and deep in doubt.
Then You showed me gentleness and mercy.
You turned me around; I was lost and now I'm found.
And now I walk this road again.
See I was [F]thinkin'...'bout my situation.
I was wantin' the things that this world brings,
Thinking maybe God wasn't [C]enough.
Then it [F]hit me that sacrifice of glory
Was sent to heal me, so He would lead me,
And then [C]show me the love from [F]above.
